notes.title: Time Warrior Z VR Halloween Update! 20% OFF!
notes.notes:
In this Update we added the new Halloween Level or Level 7.

Halloween :
In this new level you will have to fight off the evil Pumpkins with the bloody machete. Watch out, these fellows are jumping from everywhere!!

Expect Soon:
Level 8 - Cardboard City
Level Selection
Weapons of choice!

notes.title: Time Warrior Z VR NOW FOR OCULUS!
notes.notes:
This is the second major update in Time Warrior Z VR. With this update we fixed some issues with the graphics and weapons. Full update notes down below:

[b]Major Update![/b]
Time Warrior Z VR is officially released for Oculus as well. Now everybody who owns Oculus Rift or Rift S will be able to purchase the game and play it :)

Game:

Fixed the hand pose for the "Vinkel" in the Mine.
Changed some of the textures in the levels.

Audio

Added Music and Slicing effects in Level 6 The Digital World

Bugs&Fixes

Fixed the "No Texture" bug in the Dojo
Fixed the Slicing in all the levels

What to expect in the next update:

Level 7 - Cardboard City
Level Choosing System
Texture changes

notes.title: Level 6 is Out 10% OFF!
notes.notes:
In this Update we added the new Digitial World Level or Level 6.
Also fixed the bugs when it didn't cut through the object if you were really fast.

Expect Soon:
Fix for the Space level
Oculus Rift Support!!

notes.title: Update 4.15.19
notes.notes:
This is the first major update in Time Warrior Z VR. With this update we fixed some issues with the graphics and switched the old weapons with new and better ones. Full update notes down below:

[b]Game[/b]:

[list]
[*] Added new weapon and new creatures in the Space level
[*] Added new Ship with a new axe in the Viking level
[*] Changed the "Vinkel" in the Pernik level
[/list]

[b]Audio[/b]

[list]
[*] Added slicing effects on the creatures that didn't had any
[/list]

[b]Bugs[/b]

[list]
[*] Fixed the bug with the timer on the space level
[*] Fixed the slicing in the Vikings level
[/list]

[b]What to expect in the next update:[/b]

[list]
[*] Level 6
[*] New environment in the Vikings level
[*] [b]Hard mode[/b]
[*] New music in the Underwater level
[/list]
